method: Opened official pages/PDFs and inspected relevant passages; chapter teaching text unchanged

sources.finding: Practical-test safety checks include controls, tyres, lighting, fluids and warnings; deficiencies require action. Seat/headrest/mirror/belt setup, parking, reversing, hill starts and effective braking are supported.

Chapter 3 sections 14, 43, 46, 50, 65–66 and chapter 4 sections 10–10d support speed/control, safe movement, securing stationary vehicles, signalling obligations and occupant protection. Relevant current provisions checked; future unrelated amendments not applied.
VTI report 980 section 4.3, hosted by Transportstyrelsen, confirms lateral and braking forces share available friction. Used only for this physical principle, not as an additional rule.
Load capacity, speed capability and replacement-size compatibility requirements support the chapter; no unsupported universal tyre specification is added.
Daytime-running-light rear/side exception, required manual intervention in darkness/poor weather and trailer lights always on during travel are confirmed.
Belt-equipped places, under-135 cm child protection and under-15 supervision duties confirmed; limited exceptions retained.

Three-and-over short occasional transport and under-three short taxi exception conditions confirmed. Rear-facing recommendation and active-airbag cautions retained as distinct from legal height threshold.
Rear-facing at least four to five years, preferably longer; 135 cm restraint rule; 140 cm active-airbag advice unless manufacturer recommends otherwise.
Airbag supplements belt; active front airbag creates severe risk for rear-facing restraints, other child restraints and short occupants. Vehicle-specific instructions remain mandatory.
Head restraint should suit the actual occupant; adjustment and seat position influence protection. No clinical treatment content included.
TSFS 2011:20 chapter 2 supports vehicle controls, protection systems, checks, manoeuvring and self-assessment.

G2_sources.title: Säten och huvudstöd
G2_sources.locator: Whiplash protection and Minska riskerna; complete body retrieved via ?accessibilityarea=easyread
G2_sources.excerpt: Är huvudstödet rätt utformat och inställt bör skaderisken kunna minska.
G2_sources.supports: Head restraint/seat design and adjustment reduce rear-impact neck-injury risk; top at crown and small head gap.
G2_sources.scope_limits: Explains protective purpose; no guarantee or claim that every whiplash mechanism is settled.

G2_sources.title: Barn i bil
G2_sources.locator: Opening explanation: relatively heavy head, undeveloped neck; rear-facing seat slows head and body together
G2_sources.excerpt: en synkroniserad uppbromsning av huvud och kropp, varvid nacken skyddas
G2_sources.supports: Rear-facing support slows head and body together and protects vulnerable neck.
G2_sources.scope_limits: General safety/technical explanation; no foreign legal requirements imported.

G2_sources.title: Så skyddar du barnen – regler och tips
G2_sources.locator: Små barn åker säkrast bakåtvänt: heavy head, fragile neck and seat taking collision forces
G2_sources.excerpt: En bakåtvänd stol tar emot de våldsamma krafterna
G2_sources.supports: Seat supports head/neck and takes collision forces; combined with Trafikverket supports body-force distribution explanation.
G2_sources.scope_limits: General safety/technical explanation; no foreign legal requirements imported.

G2_sources.title: TSFS 2013:63 – vehicle technical requirements
G2_sources.locator: Chapter 12 §§26 and 30; printed pp. 65–66 / PDF pp. 79–80
G2_sources.excerpt: Färdbromsens transmission ska vara indelad i två eller flera kretsar.
G2_sources.supports: Separate circuits and remaining, reduced braking capability after failure of one circuit.
G2_sources.scope_limits: Technical purpose only. Regulation applicability depends on vehicle approval/date; no universal performance percentage or identical braking promise.

G2_sources.title: TSFS 2017:54 – control inspection
G2_sources.locator: Annex 1 §4.2.2 printed p.46 / PDF p.50; leakage/failure assessment §4.3 pp.50–51
G2_sources.supports: A sinking pedal can indicate internal leakage; servo/pump behaviour can resemble it, so professional assessment is needed.
G2_sources.scope_limits: Symptom suggests a possible fault, not a home diagnosis. Inspection test procedures and grading are not taught.

G2_sources.publisher: Department for Infrastructure / Driver & Vehicle Agency, Northern Ireland government
G2_sources.title: Taxi Driver Manual
G2_sources.locator: Wheel balance p.47; hydraulic brakes p.49; Appendix 3 Basic vehicle faults p.181 (printed/PDF numbers agree)
G2_sources.excerpt: Vibration in steering … Front wheel out of balance; brake pedal feels spongy … air in the brake system
G2_sources.supports: Wheel imbalance is a possible vibration cause; air is a possible spongy hydraulic pedal cause.
G2_sources.fallback_reason: Exact car-wheel imbalance and air/sponginess passages not located in targeted TS/TRV searches and current TS inspection text.
G2_sources.scope_limits: Universal vehicle principles only, not Northern Ireland taxi rules. Several faults can cause similar symptoms.

G2_sources.title: V60 Twin Engine – Reservhjul
G2_sources.version: V60 Twin Engine model-year 2019 / 18w46; updated 19 March 2020
G2_sources.locator: Temporary Spare use, Varning speed restriction and prescribed pressure; full indexed source passage retrieved; direct open failed
G2_sources.supports: Temporary use, model-specific maximum speed and prescribed pressure. No numeric distance in this passage.
G2_sources.fallback_reason: TS/TRV searches located no precise operating limits. Actual vehicle handbook is necessary; manufacturer is primary source for those limits.
G2_sources.scope_limits: Illustrative 2019 Volvo handbook only. Its 80 km/h limit is not imported as a universal rule; check any stated distance/use restriction in actual handbook.

G2_sources.title: The Highway Code – Rule 120
G2_sources.excerpt: apply the footbrake firmly; do not release the pressure
G2_sources.supports: Maintain firm pressure in emergency ABS braking; steering can remain possible; stopping distance not necessarily shorter.
G2_sources.fallback_reason: Exact emergency pedal-action instruction not located in inspected TS/TRV pages.
G2_sources.scope_limits: Common ABS operation only; no UK traffic law imported.

G2_sources.title: 2011 Explorer Owner’s Guide
G2_sources.locator: Four-wheel ABS / Using ABS, printed and PDF p.272 (zero-based index 271)
G2_sources.excerpt: brake pedal pulsation may be observed during ABS braking
G2_sources.supports: Normal ABS pulsation and continuous pressure rather than pumping.
G2_sources.fallback_reason: Official Rule 120 supplies the driver action but not pulsation. Exact TS/TRV normal-feedback explanation not located; manufacturer passage verifies the technical feedback.
G2_sources.scope_limits: Model-qualified evidence of ABS feedback. No claim that every vibration is ABS or that ABS always shortens a stop.

G2_sources.publisher: Government of Western Australia – Road Safety Commission
G2_sources.title: New or used vehicle buyers
G2_sources.version: Live page; publication date not displayed in inspected passage
G2_sources.locator: Crash protection features → Structure and Crumple Zones
G2_sources.excerpt: decelerating the passenger compartment more slowly and reducing the forces acting on the occupants
G2_sources.supports: Controlled front/rear deformation absorbs crash energy while structure protects passenger compartment; reduced deceleration/forces.
G2_sources.fallback_reason: Targeted TS/TRV searches did not yield the exact deformation/energy mechanism.
G2_sources.scope_limits: Shared engineering principle only; no foreign ratings or buying rules imported.

G2_sources.title: Elektrisk utrustning och elinstallationer
G2_sources.supports: Fuse interrupts excessive current to protect an electrical circuit.
G2_sources.scope_limits: General electrical principle explained on a maritime guidance page. Not cited as legislation governing car fuse installations; no repair instruction added.
